title: The Biology Result
briefing: Government researchers find that a frontier model substantially helps postgraduate biologists troubleshoot hard laboratory procedures. It does not design a viable weapon. Agencies warn that the expertise barrier may be falling.

forecast.question: Chance an AI-assisted biological plot reaches the acquisition stage in an allied country by 2032.

briefingSignal.leansTrue: The help the model gives is of the kind that has historically separated failed attempts from successful ones. Agencies judge the uplift is probably real.
briefingSignal.leansFalse: The help the model gives is real but sits alongside barriers it does not touch, such as materials and tacit skill. Agencies judge the uplift is probably marginal.

shah.stance: One study, postgraduates, no weapon. Fund proper uplift trials with a fixed decision date and act on the result.

harcourt.stance: Catastrophic and irreversible. Screen synthesis orders now; it works whichever model is used.

chen.stance: Life sciences is the one sector where we lead. Tier the access so verified researchers lose nothing.

okafor.stance: Monitoring every biological query treats researchers as suspects. The legitimacy cost will outlast the scare.

choices.text: Fund wet-lab uplift studies with a fixed decision date.
choices.headline: Government funds controlled uplift studies and commits to a decision date.

choices.text: Tiered access: verified researchers keep full capability.
choices.headline: Full biological capability is reserved for verified researchers as a condition of UK market access.

choices.text: Mandatory DNA synthesis screening for UK providers and customers.
choices.headline: Synthesis screening becomes mandatory for UK providers and their customers.

choices.text: Require providers to monitor and report biological queries.
choices.headline: Model providers must monitor biological queries and report concerns to government.

evidencePanel.known: A 2024 red-team study found that models of that generation did not measurably raise attack-planning risk. Two years of government testing since then show how quickly that judgement is being tested.
evidencePanel.unknown: Whether help with laboratory troubleshooting removes a real barrier or one of many.
evidencePanel.whyItMatters: The consequence is catastrophic and the probability is unknown, which is the precaution problem in one line.

sources.label: RAND, The Operational Risks of AI in Large-Scale Biological Attacks (2024)
